item.title: About This Blog
item.description:
I am Colombian, have a Ph.D in pure math, and work as a content developer, translator, and consultant.

I like to always be learning new things (like for example how to make my own personal blog site outside a commercial blogging platform!), and I am trying out writing about these personal excursions. I think I will enjoy it. Making it public in case anyone finds any of it useful/interesting!

Contact me if you have any questions or comments about what you find.
